messages:
Sam: Quick sync  pricebook migration plan ready for canary cohorts. Need confirmations on pruning legacy tiers, invoice key stability, and comms cadence. Canary approach: start 5% new pricing, ramp to 25% over 72h, then 50% for 48h before full rollout if no billing regressions.
Arjun: Important  any change that touches active subscriptions must not alter existing recurring invoice amounts until renewal or explicit opt-in. How are we marking preserved subscriptions?
Mei: Billing implementation will add a preserve_tag on subscription rows and a grandfather_key on invoice_line before charge calculation. Well skip price lookup for preserved subscriptions.
Rob: On engineering side Ill expose a feature flag and cohort assignment service. Proposed flag payload:
```
price_migration:
  cohorts: [{name: "canary", pct_new: 5, duration_h: 24}, {name: "ramp", pct_new: 25, duration_h: 48}, {name: "wide", pct_new: 50, duration_h: 48}]
  preserve_lookups: true
  preserve_window_days: 30
  vendor_surge_threshold_pct: 6
```
Eve: Legal wants the renewal email language reviewed. Also need a rollback clause for refunds/credits if misbilling occurs.
Nikhil (VendorOps): Heads-up  spot GPU pass-through prices show a +2.8% delta in our pipeline. Were below the surge_threshold but monitoring. I can push alerts to the migration dashboard if delta > 4%.
Arjun: We should also gate if any SKU negative-margin risk detected. Mei, can billing publish a line-level margin estimate during the dry run?
Mei: Yes, dry run will include fields: product_id, old_price, new_price, line_margin_delta_pct, ledger_key, preserve_key. Sample CSV header:
```
product_id,old_price,new_price,line_margin_delta_pct,ledger_key,preserve_key,notes
embed-std,0.0007,0.00065,-7.14%,ledger_embed_v1,embed_preserve_2026,apply to existing subs only
```
BillingBot: Dry run scheduled: run_id=inv-dry-222333; dataset=staging_meter_march_2026; output=/shared/finance/migrations/inv-dry-222333.csv; eta=25m.
Sam: Great. Rob please ensure cohort assignment is deterministic so ledger keys don't flip for a subscription mid-cycle.
Rob: Will do. Well hash by subscription_id + epoch and persist cohort tag on the account row in the DB.
Arjun: For ledger reconciliation, we must keep product_id stable. If we rename SKUs in new pricebook, add canonical_sku column mapping old->new. Otherwise invoices will show duplicates.
Mei: Affirmative. CSV will include canonical_sku and ledger_key. Well also produce a reconciliation diff between dry-run invoices and current baseline.
Eve: Approving comms copy pending a final line on refunds policy. Legal ok to proceed with phase1 after that.
Nikhil (VendorOps): No blocker from VendorOps as long as surge alerts are wired.
Sam: Final ask  can finance sign-off on phase1 if dry run shows no >0.5% invoice count delta and <0.2% net billing delta?
Arjun: I can sign if those thresholds hold.
Mei: Ill post dry-run results and the reconciliation diff when ready.
Sam: Targeting phase1 toggle 07:00 UTC tomorrow. If all approvals in the thread are green by EOD today we flip. Thanks all.
